description: This pie chart details the distribution of mathematical topics within the Odyssey Math dataset, specifically categorizing problems by subject and difficulty level. The chart contains 11 slices, each representing a different mathematical area. These are, in order from largest to smallest slice: Algebra – High School (17.83%, 69 problems), Pre-Calculus – High School (14.21%, 55 problems), Combinatorics – Olympiad-level (9.56%, 37 problems), Geometry – Olympiad-level (6.46%, 25 problems), Linear Algebra and Abstract Algebra – University-level (6.46%, 25 problems), Calculus and Analysis – University-level (6.20%, 24 problems), Differential Equations – University-level (3.62%, 14 problems), Probability – University-level (3.62%, 14 problems), Algebra – Olympiad-level (21.19%, 82 problems), Geometry – High School (3.62%, 14 problems), and Olympiad-level (1.03%, 4 problems). The slices are colored in a variety of shades including teal, orange, pink, and blue. Each slice is labeled with its category and corresponding percentage and problem count, and a legend is included to the side of the chart.
